# Jarvising

> jarvising (verb, present participle of *jarvis*; also noun): 1. The act of creating innovative projects at scale. 2. Giving people the tools to do it themselves.

jarvising.com is an open portfolio of test projects, experiments and tools built by Jack Stovell (https://jstov.uk/). Projects are published here as they are built, each showing what it does, how it was made, and how to make your own.

## Status

- Holding page live (September 2026). First project entries are in progress.

## Pages

- [Home](https://jarvising.com/): the dictionary entry for "jarvising" and the portfolio index.

## Related

- [jstov.uk](https://jstov.uk/): Jack Stovell's personal site.
